The calendar week is displayed in digital digits using the KSE Chromea LC Type 4 font, which was specifically developed for mobile devices and offers faster visual perception.

Settings can be configured. The status bar indicates whether it is a leap year with 53 calendar weeks. A short audio signal sounds when selecting the calendar week and the calendar year — With „Today “ the current calendar week with the corresponding working days is displayed directly.
